entries.title: Campfire Combustion with Rising Sparks
entries.description: A stack of wooden logs arranged in a cone slowly blackens and shrinks as orange-red particle flames flicker between them, emitting glowing spark particles that rise, fade, and leave short trails while a transparent heat “halo” shimmers above the fire.

entries.title: Candle Flame and Melting Wax
entries.description: A candle with a solid colored wax cylinder and a thin wick shows a small teardrop flame that flickers and changes color from blue at the base to yellow at the tip, while molten wax slowly pools, drips down the sides, and hardens as a semi-transparent coating.

entries.title: Bunsen Burner Flame Color with Different Gases
entries.description: A vertical burner tube on a lab bench emits flames whose color and height change as labeled gas spheres (methane, propane, hydrogen) attach to the base, while sliders or rotating knobs adjust air intake and produce blue, yellow, or nearly invisible flames.

entries.title: Forest Fire Spreading Across a Hillside
entries.description: A light-green, gently sloped terrain with hundreds of small cone “trees” shows a fire front that ignites nearby trees, causing them to glow, produce smoke particles, and collapse into blackened stumps, with wind arrows controlling the direction and speed of spread.

entries.title: Rocket Engine Combustion Chamber Cross-Section
entries.description: A cutaway view of a rocket engine shows fuel and oxidizer particles injected from opposite sides into a combustion chamber, where they mix, ignite into a bright, pulsating flame, and exhaust as a high-speed jet with particle trails and a thrust meter.

entries.title: Internal Combustion Engine Cylinder Animation
entries.description: A transparent engine cylinder with a moving piston and crankshaft shows colored gas particles entering, compressing, igniting as a bright expanding flame front, and exhausting, with labels for intake, compression, power, and exhaust strokes and a rotating flywheel.

entries.title: Matches in a Box: Ignition and Chain Reaction
entries.description: A half-open matchbox with many small cylindrical matchsticks lays on a table; igniting one match creates a growing flame that can tilt, fall, and ignite neighboring matches, each leaving a blackened, shortened stick and a smoke trail as the fire propagates.

entries.title: Microscopic View of Burning Fuel Droplets
entries.description: Several suspended transparent fuel spheres in a light environment burn in air, forming shrinking droplets with bright surface flames and thin blue halos, while tiny oxidizer particles collide, stick, react, and leave behind expanding spherical shells of hot gas.
entries.seed: Microscopic View of Burning Fuel Droplets: Several suspended transparent fuel spheres in a light environment burn in air, forming shrinking droplets with bright surface flames and thin blue halos, while tiny oxidizer particles collide, stick, react, and leave behind expanding spherical shells of hot gas.

entries.title: Fireworks Shell Burst and Combustion Trails
entries.description: Spherical fireworks shells rise from a launch tube with glowing trails, then explode at the top into hundreds of colored spark particles that radiate outward, burn briefly with changing colors and lengths of trails, and fade while smoke clouds expand and drift.

entries.title: Charcoal Grill with Glowing Coals and Rising Heat
entries.description: A shallow grill holds irregular charcoal briquettes that gradually transition from dark gray to glowing red-orange cores, emitting faint flickering flames and translucent heat waves upward, while a metal grate above can hold food cubes that blacken and drip.

entries.title: Chemical Flame Test: Metal Ions in a Burner
entries.description: A series of small labeled rods dipped into a central burner flame cause the flame to temporarily change color (green, purple, orange, red) and intensity around the rod, with a color legend and a bar graph showing relative emission intensity over time.

entries.title: Controlled Lab Explosion in a Closed Chamber
entries.description: A transparent spherical chamber with pressure and temperature gauges contains a fuel-oxidizer mix; when ignited at a point, a bright expanding combustion front propagates outward, compressing the shell slightly, then sending shockwave ripples through labeled air particles.

entries.title: Wildfire Versus Firebreaks on a Landscape Grid
entries.description: A patchwork terrain of grass, trees, and bare soil cells shows fire spreading cell-to-cell, stopping or slowing at wide bare soil/firebreak strips, with color-coding for unburned, burning, burned, and resistant patches and an adjustable wind vector arrow.

entries.title: Flame Propagation Along a Gas Pipe with Leaks
entries.description: A long horizontal gas pipe with multiple leak points emits faint particle streams; once one leak is ignited, a flame front travels along the external gas clouds, wrapping around the pipe, occasionally flashing back to ignite new leaks and leaving scorched marks.

entries.title: Smoldering Combustion in a Pile of Sawdust
entries.description: A mound of granular sawdust particles smolders from an ignition point inside, with an internal glowing red region slowly migrating, releasing small smoke plumes through the surface, and leaving a darkened, charred trail that expands without visible open flames.

entries.title: Backdraft in a Room with Limited Ventilation
entries.description: A simple room with a door and window starts smoke-filled and hot but with no visible flames; when the door opens, a rush of fresh air (arrows and particles) mixes with hot gases, then a sudden flame front ignites and rapidly expands, licking along the ceiling.
